facts.fact: Google's help page states that recommended events require additional context to be meaningful and are therefore not sent automatically.
facts.quote: Because these events require additional context to be meaningful, they're not sent automatically.

facts.fact: The 'For all properties' recommended events list includes 14 events recommended to all customers in all business verticals, including purchase, login, sign_up, and search.
facts.quote: We recommend these events to all customers in all business verticals.

facts.fact: Google recommends the lead generation events (generate_lead, qualify_lead, disqualify_lead, working_lead, close_convert_lead, close_unconvert_lead) for business-to-business, automotive, insurance sales, or offline conversions, populating the Lead acquisition report.
facts.quote: They're useful for business-to-business sales, automotive sales, insurance sales, or generally for when conversions occur offline. Sending these events populates the Lead acquisition report.

facts.fact: By default, the Events report shows three event recommendations at the top of the Events table.
facts.quote: Three recommendations appear at the top of the Events table by default.

facts.fact: The Events report bases event recommendations on data already collected or on the app category in the Google Play Store or iOS App Store (e.g., ecommerce, travel).
facts.quote: The **Events** report provides recommendations on events to collect based on the data you already collect or the app category in the Google Play Store or iOS App Store (e.g., ecommerce, travel).

facts.fact: The recommended event tutorial_begin is triggered when a user begins a tutorial during an on-boarding process.
facts.quote: | [tutorial_begin](https://developers.google.com/analytics/devguides/collection/ga4/reference/events#tutorial_begin) | begins a tutorial during an on-boarding process |

facts.fact: The recommended event earn_virtual_currency is triggered when a user earns virtual currency such as coins, gems, or tokens.
facts.quote: | [earn_virtual_currency](https://developers.google.com/analytics/devguides/collection/ga4/reference/events#earn_virtual_currency) | earns virtual currency (coins, gems, tokens, etc.) |

facts.fact: Upgrading to Android SDK 17.2.5 or later and/or iOS SDK 16.20.0 or later removes item data from standard event parameters, so item data is only accessible within the repeated items array.
facts.quote: you will only be able to access item data within the repeated items array; item data will no longer be available in standard event parameters

facts.fact: The minimum iOS SDK version that moves item data into the repeated items array (removing it from standard event parameters) is 16.20.0.
facts.quote: planning to upgrade to Android 17.2.5 (or later) and/or iOS 16.20.0 (or later)

facts.fact: The upgrade to the newer SDK versions changes the BigQuery schema so item/product data appears in a repeated field.
facts.quote: There is a BigQuery schema format change during this upgrade. Item/product data will begin to appear in a repeated field
